function.name: start_exploration
function.description: Starts an exploration when you need to investigate before you can answer or plan. Use when the path forward is unclear and you need to discover what's relevant through investigation.

question.description: The question or goal driving the exploration. 1-2 sentences.

direction.description: What you will investigate first. 1-2 sentences.

function.name: exploration_step
function.description: Records what you learned from investigation and decides the next action. Call after each investigation step during exploration.

internal.description: Technical details for your own context: IDs found, query results, data needed for next steps. Not shown to user.

learned.description: User-facing summary of what you discovered. Use names and links, never raw IDs. 1-2 sentences.

decision.description: Next action: continue exploring, answer the question, or create a plan

next.description: If continuing, what to investigate next

function.name: create_plan
function.description: Creates a step-by-step plan for completing a task. Use when you know what needs to be done and can define concrete steps upfront. Often follows exploration when the path becomes clear.

task.description: Clear description of the overall task to accomplish. 1-2 sentences.

steps.description: Ordered list of steps to complete the task. Each step should be concrete and actionable. 1-2 sentences each.

function.name: complete_step
function.description: Marks the current plan step as completed. Call this after you have finished executing the current step.

internal.description: Technical context for subsequent steps: IDs, counts, data references. Not shown to user.

summary.description: User-facing summary of what was accomplished. Use names and links, never raw IDs. 1-2 sentences.

function.name: ask
function.description: Pauses execution to ask the user a question, then continues where you left off. Use when you need clarification or a decision but want to resume the current plan/exploration after the user responds. The plan is preserved.

question.description: The question to ask the user. 1-2 sentences.

options.description: Optional quick-reply choices when there are clear alternatives.

value.description: Value sent as user response when selected

function.name: abort
function.description: Aborts the current plan and returns to chat mode. Use when you are fundamentally blocked and cannot continue even with clarification. The plan is discarded. Prefer `ask` if you just need user input to continue.

message.description: Message to the user explaining why execution stopped
